name: PGP Key Lookup
summary: Finds OpenPGP public keys on public key directories by email address or key fingerprint. Desktop only.
description:
For pivoting on an email address through its OpenPGP keys: each key found is linked to every address in its User IDs, so one address or fingerprint can lead to all the other addresses attached to the same key, not only the one asked about.

**Needs:** no API key or account.

**Who sees it:** all four directories receive the email address or fingerprint for every selected node, anonymously. Every request is an exact lookup by address or fingerprint; the HKP index search is never used, so nothing is enumerated or harvested in bulk. The address owner is never contacted.

**Read results with care:**
- keys.openpgp.org and keys.mailvelope.com publish a User ID only after the address owner confirms it by email. keyserver.ubuntu.com and pgpkeys.eu publish whatever is uploaded, so anyone can put a key there that names anyone's address. `user_id_sources` records which kind of directory served each User ID.
- No signature is verified. v2 and v3 keys are not read, and expiry and revocation are read from v4 signatures only.
- Web Key Directory (WKD) is not queried. If no directory answers at all, the run fails instead of reporting "no keys".

**Data and licences:** public keys as the four directories publish them; this repository does not restate the directories' terms.

**Source:** https://github.com/Vineyard-Intelligence/pluginpack-pgp-lookup (Apache-2.0)

plugins.name: PGP Key Lookup
plugins.description: Looks up OpenPGP public keys on keys.openpgp.org, keyserver.ubuntu.com, pgpkeys.eu and keys.mailvelope.com: by address for each selected Email Address, by fingerprint for each selected PGP Key. Creates one PGP Key node per distinct fingerprint (key ID, algorithm, key size, creation/expiration, User IDs, revocation, armored key, sources, and user_id_sources: per User ID, the directories that served it and whether one of them verifies addresses), and an Email Address node for every address in its User IDs, linked "key bound to". Desktop only.

network.purpose: Look up keys by each selected email address or key fingerprint on keys.openpgp.org.

web_probe.purpose: Look up keys by each selected email address or key fingerprint on keyserver.ubuntu.com, pgpkeys.eu and keys.mailvelope.com.
